acceptanceCriteria: queue status reports the number of registered waiting writers and the caller's would-be rank, read without taking the preparation lock, or NOT_OBSERVED when it cannot observe them.
Any estimated wait is derived from recorded per-mutation cost with its basis named, or omitted; it is never presented as a guarantee.
A test with N registered waiters shows the reported rank and that the read writes nothing.
body: Supervisors cannot see admission pressure until a mutation fails LOCK_TIMEOUT after the 30 s preparation budget. Requested by the owner in a beamfall/corvint issue 494 comment (2026-10-05T02:44:57Z, Flow-Proof fleet data point on main-cd70ba0: ~8,900 receipts, 13 concurrent sessions, pooled claim LOCK_TIMEOUT at rank 13; heartbeat/renew LOCK_TIMEOUT while the lease was FRESH was misread by the client as fencing). queue status (internal/tasks/cli/cli.go queueStatus) is read-only and must stay lock-free (Invariant 4); the rank and wait must be reported as observed facts or NOT_OBSERVED, never invented. V1-0645 (writer cost) reduces the underlying cost; this ticket makes the pressure visible.

completion.reason: Every acceptance criterion is met: lock-free waiting-writer count and rank or NOT_OBSERVED (CAL-V0-095), wait estimate NOT_OBSERVED with its basis named, TestCALV0095_QueueStatusAdmissionPressure shows rank with byte-identical stores. Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-05-v1-0781-admission-rank.md at 618680492cf8. Verified at 618680492cf8 (merge of beamfall/corvint#574); CI on #574 green (go-product shards, go-interop, doc-gates). make gate, live store qualification and batch dogfood rebinding are NOT_RUN.

title: corvint-tasks: expose current writer-admission rank and an estimated wait in queue status so supervisors can back off before queueing
